person: Ruth Albers, 63, keeps the books for her family's thousand-acre corn and soybean farm in central Iowa. The farm holds a USDA value-added grant to put in a seed-cleaning and bagging line, paid by reimbursement only. The quarter closed September 30, and she is working on it at night on her phone between harvest chores. She still remembers a neighbour losing his hail claim to a missed deadline. She wants to know exactly what is drawn and what is filed, and she does not trust anything that submits to the government on its own.
stated_up_front: Quarter ended Sept 30 on the seed-cleaning grant and I need to get our draw in and the federal report done. Go through what we spent and tell me what's good to claim. I want to see it before anything gets sent to USDA.

facts.truth: $75,000 USDA value-added grant for the seed-cleaning and bagging line, running May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2028, paid by reimbursement only.
In July we drew $4,180 for the bagging scale and nothing else. The first report covered through June 30.
The seed conditioner, $11,400, was paid in March 2026 before the award began. It was recoded to the grant in September, so it can't be claimed.
$1,265 for beer and catered brats. It's coded to the grant, but the beer at least is not allowable.
A $2,500 assessment from the state grain group, coded to the grant. The letter says it is all for their lobbying work.
A $312 IRS penalty for a late payroll tax deposit in August. It's coded to the grant, but it's a penalty.
$3,900 in cover crop seed is coded to this grant but belongs to our NRCS conservation contract.
$2,760 for bagging supplies from the Ames supplier. The invoice is dated September 22, is due November 5, and has not been paid.
Dale is on payroll at 50% to the grant, but his timesheets show about 15% of his time on the seed line and the rest on field work.
The electrician's $6,850 for the wiring on the cleaning shed was paid September 9, and the $9,200 conveyor was paid August 20. Both are for the seed line.

unknowns: Whether the beer and brats at the field day could be allowed at all, or only the food part
The date the federal report is actually due for this quarter
Whether the late payroll tax penalty is ever something the grant can carry
Whether the grant allows any share of her own bookkeeping time
